name: Itsuwari no Hanayome, Chizome no Dress
original_name: 偽りの花嫁、血染めのドレス
source:
Spring. April.

Starting today, I'm a high school student. It's the beginning of a new life.
On the day of the entrance ceremony, Ibuki reunites with his first love, Mifue, to whom he promised marriage when they were young. Ibuki thought Mifue was a girl, but as it turned out, Mifue was a guy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25606]Freem![/url]]
translation:
春天。四月。

从今天开始，我就是一名高中生了。这是新生活的开始。
入学典礼当天，伊吹与年轻时许诺结婚的初恋美笛重逢。伊吹以为美未来是个女孩，但事实证明，美未来是个男人。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25606]Freem![/url]]
